scope.S78-SOURCE: Add a bounded replaceable issuer-holdings client for the allowlisted official Vanguard Advisors BND latest-holdings endpoint with immutable BND-to-port-ID 0928 configuration, disabled unsafe redirects, bounded timeouts/retries/bytes/rows, strict duplicate-key JSON parsing and attributable provider/source/effective-date metadata.
scope.S78-PROOF: Parse every numeric percentOfFunds as an exact finite nonnegative percentage point value and permit blank strings only as explicitly unweighted unknown rows. Select and publish exactly the ten largest known rows only when the known exact sum is at most 100 and the total unknown residual 100 minus that sum is strictly smaller than the tenth-largest known weight, proving no unknown row can displace the selected ten. Never impute, zero-fill, publish or deduplicate unknown rows or repeated named bonds.
scope.S78-FRESHNESS: Apply an explicit 1,080-hour maximum age only to Vanguard issuer-derived BND top_holdings and top_10_concentration_pct, using their source effective date. Preserve the existing configured freshness window and cap for Yahoo and every other field/source; fetch time never substitutes for observation time.
scope.S78-INTEGRATE: Compose issuer evidence only when Yahoo BND holdings are unavailable; replace top_holdings and concentration together with one provider/date and carry them through existing schema-2 publication, retrieval, screening, construction, checkpoints, PostgreSQL and dashboard integrity without altering thresholds, sleeves or allocation.
scope.S78-OPERATE: Add deterministic fixtures and bounded HTTP tests, disposable real-store end-to-end coverage, architecture/runbook/iteration documentation, and live source publication plus five-candidate portfolio verification under the approved source-specific policy.

non_goals: No global freshness-window or configuration-cap increase; 1,080 hours applies only to the two named official issuer-derived BND fields.
No weight imputation, zero-fill, publication of blank-weight rows, missing-as-pass behavior or reliance on fetch time.
No screening threshold, category-sleeve, allocation, ranking, universe membership or alternate-fund change.
No broad scraper/browser framework, authenticated endpoints, credentials, trades, brokerage writes or guaranteed-return claims.
No historical snapshot repair or rewrite; only newly fetched snapshots may use the successor contract.

invariants.I78-AUTHORITY: Issuer evidence is accepted only from the exact allowlisted HTTPS Vanguard Advisors host/path for curated BND port ID 0928; provider, canonical source URL and effective date are retained on both derived fields.
invariants.I78-RESIDUAL: Known percentages use bounded exact decimals in percentage points. Blank strings remain unknown. Let K be the exact sum of all known rows and R=100-K. Success requires 0<=K<=100, at least ten known rows, R>=0 and R strictly less than the tenth-largest known exact weight. This proves every unknown row is below the tenth-largest because unknown weights are nonnegative and collectively cannot exceed R. The ten selected exact weights and their exact sum alone define published holdings and concentration; repeated names remain distinct rows with deterministic source-order tie breaks.
invariants.I78-FRESHNESS: Only provider vanguard_advisors fields top_holdings and top_10_concentration_pct use max age 1,080 hours from the source effective-date UTC boundary. All other provenance uses the existing configured max age and future tolerance. The applied window is deterministic and visible in screening diagnostics/recomputation.
invariants.I78-FAILCLOSED: Non-200/off-host/changed-path redirects, oversized or malformed bodies, duplicate keys, wrong configuration/date bucket/collection/row types, nonblank invalid weights, negative/nonfinite/over-100 weights, known sum over 100, insufficient known rows, failed residual inequality, stale/future issuer date, contradiction or provider failure remains explicit unavailable/source-error and cannot partially publish or reach explanation/review.
invariants.I78-BOUNDARY: Fallback runs only for BND when Yahoo holdings are unavailable, replaces holdings and concentration as an atomic pair, never combines two providers within either field, never overwrites complete Yahoo evidence and never runs for another symbol. Network and clock calls remain injected and bounded.
invariants.I78-COMPAT: Issue #70 schema-1/schema-2 encoding, digest/fingerprint, immutable publication/retry, retrieval validation and all existing non-BND/complete-Yahoo behavior remain unchanged. Screening thresholds and construction rules do not change.
invariants.I78-STATE: State stays JSON serializable and persisted evidence contains sufficient provider/field information for deterministic source-specific freshness recomputation. Diagnostics expose only fixed allowlisted source/field/code attribution, never raw bodies, unexpected URLs, connection details or exception chains.

risks: The official endpoint can change shape, size, effective-date cadence or accessibility.

The proof relies on percentOfFunds semantics that known plus unknown nonnegative fund weights total no more than 100 percentage points; implementation must make that assumption explicit and fail if known data contradict it.
Repeated bond names and rounded percentage lexemes can be accidentally deduplicated or converted through float.
A provider/field freshness resolver can drift between publication and downstream recomputation.
Large response handling can create latency or memory risk if byte/row bounds are applied after full materialization.
External data may change before final live verification, producing a new honest blocker despite correct code.
escalation_triggers: The residual proof cannot be derived from documented endpoint semantics without an additional unapproved assumption.
Implementing the 45-day field-specific rule requires a schema migration, historical rewrite or global freshness relaxation.
The HTTP library cannot enforce redirect, streaming byte and timeout bounds through a replaceable interface.
A required publication/downstream recomputation path cannot preserve identical freshness decisions.
Implementation exposes unresolved concurrency, response-integrity or provider-composition ambiguity.
The inherited finite budget cannot complete required real-store and live evidence.
